scope: Pure local receipt creation from facts already present before the two legacy handoffs become lossy.

news_receipt.input_truth: Lossless normalized articles belonging to one candidate cluster plus exact matched Brain context.
preserves: one evidence item per distinct source host
holds_on: invalid subject, audience, context or relevance

decision_receipt.input_truth: Prior and current verdicts, exact watch kind, verifier evidence and an explicit effect on the live call.
holds_on: change does not earn its trigger kind
invalid audience, status, verdict or confidence

residual_risks: Receipt evidence IDs use a deterministic non-cryptographic locator fingerprint; the full URL remains present and later collision checks fail closed.
The receipt creator is not yet called transactionally with legacy qualification or verification.
No durable schema, retention, correction or erasure behavior is proven.
Decision effect quality is required but not generated or evaluated here.
